gaps.lead: Nobody in the class is as tall as Petra.
gaps.explanation: X is taller than everyone = X is the tallest (person).

gaps.answer: got me to promise to do
gaps.lead: The doctor made me promise to do the exercises daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = make/persuade them: got me to promise.

gaps.lead: The suitcase was so heavy that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ suitcase that I couldn't lift it.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective becomes such (+a) + adjective + noun: such a heavy suitcase.

gaps.lead: There were fewer people at the concert than expected.
gaps.sentence: There weren't ___ at the concert as expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (people) as expected.

gaps.lead: I haven't enjoyed myself so much for years.
gaps.sentence: It's ___ I've enjoyed myself so much.
gaps.explanation: It's years since + past simple = I haven't…for years.

gaps.lead: I'm sure he isn't in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — he was here this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't be = certainty that something is impossible (present).
